decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the selected tighter kerning, common baseline, E/L height alignment, and resulting cap-height hierarchy; no additional update or removal is required.
The same-message MODIFY already records that the second V’s left arm establishes the E/L height and its right arm alone extends above them; the remaining second-V attributes stay compatible.
The request for a perfect copy/paste of the Hero V right arm restates the existing literal-derivation and exact-copy requirements without changing current accent state.
The message uses the Hero V right arm as a fixed reference for the accent and does not alter the approved Hero V geometry or its revision policy.
The letter-height, kerning, baseline, and accent-copy refinements do not change the established brand-purpose or expression attributes.
The source decision concerns wordmark geometry and composition and does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The accent copy/paste instruction reiterates the existing unified Hero-derived terminal rule; the source does not establish a new terminal construction attribute or removal.
The composition refinement does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
